item.title: During Campaign Rally, 'Drop and Give Me Twenty'... Democratic Party Apologizes for 'Drill Controversy' (선거 유세 중 “엎드려 뻗쳐”...민주당 ‘얼차려 논란’에 사과)
item.description:
During Campaign Rally, 'Drop and Give Me Twenty'... Democratic Party Apologizes for 'Drill Controversy' (선거 유세 중 “엎드려 뻗쳐”...민주당 ‘얼차려 논란’에 사과)

A scene resembling a military 'drill' unfolded at the Democratic Party of Korea's local election campaign in Gwangyang, South Jeolla Province, where candidates were apparently ordered to perform exercises. The Democratic Party apologized and initiated disciplinary action against those involved. (더불어민주당의 전남 광양 지방선거 유세 현장에서 후보자들에게 ‘얼차려’를 시키는 듯한 장면이 연출됐다. 민주당은 사과하고 관련자 문책에 나섰다.)

At the Democratic Party's campaign event held on the 24th at the Okgok Five-Day Market in Gwangyang, South Jeolla, a supporter identified as A, who was holding a microphone, issued commands such as "Attention," "At ease," "Sit down," and "Stand up" to local election candidates lined up in front of the campaign vehicle. Most of the Gwangyang mayoral and local council candidates followed these orders. Upon observing their movements, A shouted, "Look at that form! Drop and give me twenty," and some candidates actually prostrated themselves on the ground. Min Hyung-bae, the Democratic Party candidate for the integrated Gwangju-South Jeolla mayoral position, who was watching the situation, apologized, saying, "The person leading a moment ago went overboard. They meant to make it fun but got a bit carried away. I'm sorry." <<> In response, the campaign of independent Gwangyang mayoral candidate Park Seong-hyun criticized, "In broad daylight on a street, people aspiring to be mayor, provincial council members, and city council members were lining up and doing push-ups. This is not just a simple overstep; it reveals their unconscious blind obedience to the nomination power and authoritarianism embedded within them." <<> Kwon Hyang-yeop, the Democratic Party's regional committee chair for Suncheon, Gwangyang, Gokseong, and Gurye-eul, stated in a Facebook post on the 25th, "A supporter grabbed the microphone and engaged in an out-of-line act reminiscent of military roll call with the candidates. I deeply apologize," adding, "We have decided to remove the individual from their position on the election campaign committee and submit a disciplinary petition to the South Jeolla provincial party chapter." (지난 24일 전남 광양시 옥곡 5일장에서 열린 민주당 유세 현장에서 마이크를 잡은 지지자 A씨가 유세 차량 앞에 늘어선 지방선거 후보들에게 “차렷” “열중쉬어” “앉아” “일어서” 등을 지시했다. 차량 앞에 있던 광양시장과 지방의원 후보들은 대다수 이 지시를 따랐다. A씨는 이들의 움직임을 보고는 “동작 봐라. 엎드려뻗쳐”라고 외쳤고, 실제 일부 후보들이 땅에 엎드리기도 했다. 상황을 지켜보던 민형배 전남광주통합시장 후보는 “조금 전에 진행하시는 분이 ‘오버’를 했다. 재미있게 해보시려 한 건데 조금 오버를 했다. 죄송하다”고 사과했다.)

item.title: Cho Kuk: “Kim Yong-nam’s ‘Loan Shark Allegations’ Negatively Impact Seoul and Yeongnam Elections… Must Resolve It Themselves” (조국 “김용남 ‘대부업 의혹’, 서울·영남 선거 악영향…결자해지해야”)
item.description:
Cho Kuk: “Kim Yong-nam’s ‘Loan Shark Allegations’ Negatively Impact Seoul and Yeongnam Elections… Must Resolve It Themselves” (조국 “김용남 ‘대부업 의혹’, 서울·영남 선거 악영향…결자해지해야”)

Cho Kuk, candidate for the Pyeongtaek-eul by-election for the National Assembly under the Fatherland Innovation Party, stated that allegations of the Democratic Party of Korea candidate Kim Yong-nam’s “borrowed name loan shark operation” are “having a very negative impact on elections in Seoul and the Yeongnam region, which are considered battleground areas.” (조국 조국혁신당 평택을 국회의원 재선거 후보는 더불어민주당 김용남 후보의 ‘차명 대부업 운영’ 의혹에 대해 “접전 지역이라고 할 수 있는 서울과 영남 지역 선거에 매우 악영향을 주고 있다”고 밝혔다.)

In a CBS radio interview on the 25th, Cho said, “My hometown is Busan, and friends from Busan contacted me saying, ‘When we say the People Power Party is not acceptable (to people around us), they bring up Kim Yong-nam, and then it shuts things down.’” He added, “In particular, the momentum of supporters and party members who are working hard in the democratic reform camp is weakening.” (조 후보는 25일 CBS라디오 인터뷰에서 “제 고향이 부산인데, 부산 친구들이 연락이 와서 ‘(주변에) 국민의힘은 안 된다고 하면 김용남 얘기를 하는데, 그러면 막혀버린다’고 한다”며 이같이 말했다. 조 후보는 “특히 민주개혁 진영에서 열심히 뛰는 분들의 지지자들, 당원들의 동력이 떨어지고 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding the Democratic Party’s response the previous day to the Fatherland Innovation Party’s call for an ethics investigation, which was to “maintain restraint,” Cho said, “Is it a solution to just say, ‘Since he’s a talent of the Democratic Party, don’t bother about it; we’ll handle it ourselves’? I don’t think so.” He continued, “As our party, I believe we can at least tell the Democratic Party to ‘take responsible measures.’ The Democratic Party, as a responsible party, and Candidate Kim, as a responsible politician, must clarify their positions.” (민주당이 전날 조국혁신당의 윤리감찰 촉구에 대해 ‘금도를 지켜달라’고 반응한 데 대해선 “지금 문제가 단순히 ‘민주당 인재니까 아무도 신경 쓰지 마. 우리가 알아서 할게’라고 답하는 게 해결책인가. 저는 아니라고 본다”고 했다. 조 대표는 “우당으로서 민주당에 ‘책임 있는 조치를 하라’는 정도는 얘기할 수 있다고 본다”면서 “민주당이 책임 있는 정당으로서, 김 후보도 책임 있는 정치인으로서 확실한 입장을 밝혀야 한다”고 했다)

Cho stated, “The responsible party, the ruling party, and the big brother party of the democratic reform camp must resolve this themselves.” He added, “There are ways for both the party and Candidate Kim individually to act.” He also said, “This Pyeongtaek-eul by-election occurred due to the Democratic Party’s fault,” and “The various issues surrounding Candidate Kim are significant enough to cause another such by-election.” This was interpreted as essentially urging Kim to step down. (조 후보는 “책임 있는 정당, 집권 정당, 민주개혁 진영 맏형 정당이 결자해지해야 한다”면서 “당과 김 후보 개인이 각각 할 수 있는 방법이 있다”고 했다. 또 “이번 평택을 선거가 민주당 귀책 사유로 발생한 것”이라며 “지금 김 후보와 관련한 여러 사유는 다시 그런 재선거를 야기할 수 있을 정도의 사안”이라고 했다. 사실상 김 후보의 사퇴를 촉구한 것으로 해석됐다.)

Regarding President Lee Jae-myung’s mention of the need to consider shutting down sites like Ilbe, Cho said, “The Ilbe-style behavior of hate-mongering is an evil that corrodes democracy.” <<>> (조 후보는 이재명 대통령이 일간베스트(일베) 등의 폐쇄 검토 필요성을 언급한 데 대해선 “일베식의 혐오·부추김 행태는 민주주의를 좀먹는 악”이라고 했다.)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: "Kim Kwan-young's Claim of 'President Lee's Consent'? Crosses the Line... Please Vote for Lee Won-taek" (정청래 “김관영 ‘李대통령 교감’? 금도 넘어…이원택 찍어달라”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae: "Kim Kwan-young's Claim of 'President Lee's Consent'? Crosses the Line... Please Vote for Lee Won-taek" (정청래 “김관영 ‘李대통령 교감’? 금도 넘어…이원택 찍어달라”)

Jung Cheong-rae, the leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, visited North Jeolla Province on the 25th and appealed for support for Lee Won-taek, the party's candidate for the provincial governor, saying, "Even if the Democratic Party has its shortcomings and disappointments, please cherish and choose the Democratic Party candidate." <<> At an on-site election strategy meeting held in Jeongeup, North Jeolla Province, Representative Jung stated, "North Jeolla Province can develop further when the President is Lee Jae-myung of the Democratic Party, the North Jeolla Province governor is from the Democratic Party, and the National Assembly members are from the Democratic Party." Although North Jeolla Province is a traditional stronghold for the Democratic Party, incumbent Governor Kim Kwan-young, who was expelled from the party and is running as an independent amid suspicions over the distribution of proxy payments, has recorded high approval ratings, turning the race into a fierce battleground. <<> Representative Jung said, "This local election is an evaluation of the report card for the first year of the Lee Jae-myung administration," adding, "If you like and support President Lee, please vote for the Democratic Party candidate Lee Won-taek. President Lee is also a member of the Democratic Party." He further argued, "A golden opportunity for North Jeolla Province's development, including the Saemangeum project, has arrived," and "The Lee Jae-myung administration is dedicating sincere efforts to the development of North Jeolla Province, and budgets and laws are impossible without the Democratic Party." <<> Regarding candidate Kim Kwan-young, who sparked a 'prior consultation controversy' by stating he had "told President Lee about the inevitability of running as an independent," Representative Jung criticized him for "spreading serious falsehoods," calling it "a act that goes far beyond the bounds." He stated, "This crosses the line, and by a long shot," adding, "We cannot simply overlook this matter." Representative Jung continued, "When I checked with the presidential office, they vehemently denied it, saying it's not true," and asked, "Would President Lee have consulted with an independent candidate? I urge the person who made the statement to offer a detailed explanation and apologize if there is something to apologize for." <<> Floor Leader Han Byung-do also remarked, "Don't use the President for your own vote-getting," and stressed, "No matter how urgent it is, there are lines that must not be crossed." Regarding Kim's claim that he was unfairly expelled, Floor Leader Han dismissed it as "mere rumor-mongering to open a political path for himself." (정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 25일 전북을 찾아 “민주당이 부족하고 서운한 점이 있더라도 민주당 소속 후보를 아끼고 선택해달라”면서 이원택 전북지사 후보 지지를 호소했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "The Ruling Party's 'Death Song' is Aimed at Starbucks This Election... It's a 'People's Trial' for Local Elections" (장동혁 “與, 이번 선거엔 스타벅스로 죽창가...지방선거용 인민재판”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk: "The Ruling Party's 'Death Song' is Aimed at Starbucks This Election... It's a 'People's Trial' for Local Elections" (장동혁 “與, 이번 선거엔 스타벅스로 죽창가...지방선거용 인민재판”)

Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, on the 25th criticized President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party of Korea for their harsh condemnation of Starbucks Korea, which sparked controversy over a "Tanker Day" event, saying, "They are trying to divert public anger over the 'Lee Jae-myung trial cancellation special counsel' to Starbucks," and called it a "people's trial for local elections." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 25일 이재명 대통령과 더불어민주당이 ‘탱크데이’ 이벤트로 논란을 자초한 스타벅스코리아를 강경 비판하는 데 대해 “’이재명 재판 취소 특검’에 분노한 민심을 스타벅스로 돌리려 한다”면서 “지방선거용 인민재판”이라고 말했다.)

At a meeting of the Central Election Strategy Committee held that morning at the party's headquarters in Yeouido, Seoul, Jang stated, "This election's 'death song' target is Starbucks. Is it the death song or Starbucks? I hope the people will judge." (장 대표는 이날 오전 서울 여의도 중앙당사에서 열린 중앙선거대책위원회의에서 “이번 선거 죽창가의 대상은 스타벅스다. 죽창가냐 스타벅스냐. 국민들께서 심판해 주기 바란다”면서 이같이 말했다.)

Jang added, "I'll make one prediction: the Starbucks boycott period will end exactly on June 3. After that day, it will be as if nothing happened, and Lee Jae-myung's Democratic Party and its 'Gaeddal' (hardcore supporters) will be carrying Starbucks coffee." He emphasized, "If we are to address Starbucks' insult to May 18, we must first withdraw the nominations of Incheon's Song Young-gil and Gangwon Province's Woo Sang-ho, who were drinking with hostesses in Gwangju on the eve of May 18. Jung Won-oh, who uses May 18 as a shield for drunk violence, should also step down." (장 대표는 “예언 하나 하겠다. 스타벅스 불매 운동 기한은 딱 6월 3일까지”라면서 “이재명 민주당과 개딸은 그날만 지나면 무슨 일이 있었냐는 듯 스타벅스 커피를 들고 다닐 것”이라고 했다. 장 대표는 “스타벅스의 5·18 모독을 따지려면 먼저 5·18 전야 광주에서 접대부들과 술 먹고 놀았던 인천의 송영길, 강원도의 우상호 공천부터 철회해야 한다”면서 “5·18을 주취 폭행의 방패로 삼고 있는 정원오도 사퇴해야 한다”고 강조했다.)

Jang said, "This Friday, I urge the people to clearly show the will of free citizens to choose their own coffee. This election is a confrontation between Lee Jae-myung's 'Gaeddal' and free citizens." (장 대표는 “이번 주 금요일 국민들께서는 내 커피는 내가 고른다는 자유시민의 의지를 확실하게 보여달라”며 “이번 선거는 이재명 개딸과 자유시민의 대결”이라고 했다.)

Meanwhile, People Power Party lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun also posted a photo on social media of himself drinking coffee at Starbucks that same morning, saying, "I want to live in a country where I, not the state, decide the coffee I drink." (한편 김기현 국민의힘 의원도 같은 날 오전 스타벅스에서 커피를 마시는 사진을 소셜 미디어에 올리면서 “나는 내가 마실 커피를 국가가 결정하는 것이 아니라 내가 선택할 자유가 있는 나라에서 살고 싶다”고 했다.)

item.title: Jeon Jae-soo "Pushing for Increase in Childcare Center Meal Costs" (전재수 “어린이집 급식단가 인상 추진”)
item.description:
Jeon Jae-soo "Pushing for Increase in Childcare Center Meal Costs" (전재수 “어린이집 급식단가 인상 추진”)

Jeon Jae-soo, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Busan mayor, stated on the 25th, "I will significantly raise the meal support unit cost for toddlers at childcare centers to the level of kindergartens." (더불어민주당 전재수 부산시장 후보가 25일 “어린이집 유아 급식 지원 단가를 유치원 수준으로 대폭 인상하겠다”고 했다.)

The candidate made this remark, saying, "In Busan, the meal support unit cost for children aged 3 to 5 is 3,660 won for kindergartens, but only 1,160 won for childcare centers." He added, "Once I become Busan mayor, I will work with the education office and district/county offices to raise the meal support unit cost for childcare center toddlers to match the levels of other local governments such as Seoul, Gyeonggi, and North Chungcheong." (전 후보는 이날 “부산 시내 만 3~5세 유아 급식 지원 단가는 유치원이 3660원인데 반해 어린이집은 1160원에 불과하다”면서 이같이 밝혔다. 그러면서 “부산시장이 되면 서울·경기·충북 등 다른 지자체 수준에 맞춰 교육청과 자치구·군 협력을 통해 어린이집 유아 급식 단가 인상을 추진하겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

According to the Busan Metropolitan City Childcare Center Association, when children aged 3 to 5 attend kindergartens in Busan, the Busan Metropolitan Office of Education covers the full meal cost of 3,660 won. In contrast, for childcare centers, Busan city and district/county offices each pay half, providing only 1,160 won in subsidies, with the shortfall being borne by the childcare centers themselves. (부산광역시 어린이집 연합회에 따르면, 현재 부산 지역 만 3~5세 유아가 유치원에 다닐 경우 부산시교육청에서 급식 단가 3660원 전액을 지원받는다. 그에 반해 어린이집은 부산시와 구·군이 절반씩 부담해 1160원만 보조하고, 부족분은 어린이집이 자체 부담하고 있다.)

Seoul has pushed for free meals for toddlers at childcare centers since 2022, aligning meal costs with kindergarten levels. North Chungcheong Province also raised the meal support unit cost for childcare centers to 3,000 won this year. Gyeonggi Province has been gradually increasing the support unit cost, expanding it to around 3,150 won this year. (서울시는 2022년부터 어린이집 유아 무상급식을 추진하며 급식 단가를 유치원 수준으로 현실화했다. 충북도 올해 어린이집 급식 지원 단가를 3000원으로 상향했다. 경기도 역시 단계적으로 지원 단가를 끌어올려 올해 3150원 수준까지 확대했다.)

Candidate Jeon stated, "In Busan, both meals for the elderly and toddlers still remain at the lowest levels nationwide," and added, "If elected as mayor, I will focus on raising meal costs and improving quality for toddlers through cooperation between the education office and local governments." (전 후보는 “(부산에서) 노인 급식과 유아 급식은 여전히 전국 최하위권 수준에 머물고 있다”며 “시장에 당선되면 교육청과 기초지자체 협력을 통해 유아 급식 단가 인상과 품질 개선에 집중하겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: Aftermath of Suspended Opposition Unity in Ulsan Mayoral Race... Progressive Kim Jong-hoon Demands, "Kim Sang-wook, Apologize" (범여권 울산시장 단일화 중단 여진... 진보 김종훈 “김상욱 사과하라”)
item.description:
Aftermath of Suspended Opposition Unity in Ulsan Mayoral Race... Progressive Kim Jong-hoon Demands, "Kim Sang-wook, Apologize" (범여권 울산시장 단일화 중단 여진... 진보 김종훈 “김상욱 사과하라”)

Kim Jong-hoon, the Progressive Party candidate for Ulsan mayor, stated on the 25th regarding the suspension of the opinion poll for the opposition bloc's unified candidacy by Kim Sang-wook, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate, that "the responsibility for the derailed primary lies with candidate Kim Sang-wook," and added, "I will wait until today for an apology regarding the disruption of the primary and an explanation of the suspicions surrounding interference in the opinion poll." <<> Kim made this statement during a press conference at his Ulsan election campaign office on the same day, concerning the previous day's disrupted primary. He said, "Due to candidate Kim Sang-wook's unilateral declaration of suspension, the unified candidate primary for the Ulsan mayoral race was not completed normally and ended in disarray." <<> Candidate Kim Jong-hoon further demanded, "We have confirmed circumstances suggesting that an associate of candidate Kim Sang-wook received data from the opinion poll results while the survey was in full swing. Clearly explain who confirmed the data, when, and how, and on what basis the decision to suspend the opinion poll was made." <<> He also stated, "If the existing opinion poll results are disclosed as originally agreed upon, even now, we will abide by them." Candidate Kim Jong-hoon emphasized, "This is the only viable solution for unification at this point," and added, "A unification without [the opinion poll] is impossible." <<> The previous day, the opinion poll for the opposition bloc's unified candidacy between the Democratic Party and the Progressive Party was suspended at the request of candidate Kim Sang-wook's camp. Candidate Kim Sang-wook noted, "During the opinion poll, circumstances were discovered showing a very irregular flow beyond what is typically predictable," and added, "A situation could arise where citizens' right to choose is infringed upon by the meddling of specific forces, leading to an anti-democratic scenario." <<> On YTN Radio that day, candidate Kim Sang-wook stated, "If the People Power Party selects a Democratic and Progressive candidate favorable to them for the main race, but then their supporters end up backing the People Power Party in the actual election, the effort to put forward a competitive candidate could instead result in fielding a weaker one." This suggests that the opinion poll was suspended due to concerns about strategic voting by the People Power Party's support base. (김종훈 진보당 울산시장 후보는 김상욱 더불어민주당 후보가 범여권 단일화 경선 여론조사를 중단한 것에 대해 “단일화 경선 파행의 책임은 김상욱 후보에게 있다”면서 “단일화 경선 파행에 대한 사과와 여론조사 부정 개입 의혹 해명을 오늘까지 기다리겠다”고 25일 말했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party Sees Boost from Starbucks 'Tank Day' Effect... Honam Approval Rating Jumps from 57% to 68% in a Week (與, 스타벅스 난타 효과 봤다... 호남 지지율 일주일새 57→68%)
item.description:
Democratic Party Sees Boost from Starbucks 'Tank Day' Effect... Honam Approval Rating Jumps from 57% to 68% in a Week (與, 스타벅스 난타 효과 봤다... 호남 지지율 일주일새 57→68%)

A public opinion poll shows that the approval rating of the Democratic Party of Korea in the Gwangju and Jeolla regions surged from 57.2% to 68.4% in just one week. This is attributed to the party's强硬 response to Starbucks Korea, which sparked controversy with its 'Tank Day' marketing on the May 18th anniversary. (광주·전라 지역의 더불어민주당 지지율이 일주일 새 57.2%에서 68.4%로 크게 올랐다는 여론조사 결과가 나왔다. 민주당이 5·18 기념일 ‘탱크데이’ 마케팅으로 논란을 빚은 스타벅스코리아에 대해 강경 대응했기 때문이라는 분석이다.)

According to a party approval survey conducted by pollster Realmeter on behalf of Energy Economy News from the 21st to the 22nd, targeting 1,004 voters aged 18 and over nationwide, the Democratic Party of Korea recorded 47.5%, while the People Power Party (PPP) stood at 33.3%. This was followed by the Rebuilding Korea Party at 3.4%, the Reform Party at 3.2%, and the Progressive Party at 2.3%. The Democratic Party rose 1.7 percentage points (p) from the previous week, while the PPP fell 0.2 percentage points. (여론조사기관 리얼미터가 에너지경제신문 의뢰로 21~22일 전국 18세 이상 유권자 1004명을 대상으로 집계한 정당 지지도 조사에서 더불어민주당은 47.5%, 국민의힘은 33.3%을 기록했다. 이어 조국혁신당 3.4%, 개혁신당 3.2%, 진보당 2.3% 순이었다. 민주당은 전주 대비 1.7%포인트(p) 상승했고, 국민의힘은 0.2%p 하락했다.)

Particularly noteworthy was public opinion in the Honam region, the Democratic Party's stronghold. The Democratic Party's approval rating in Honam rose 11.2 percentage points from the previous week, driving the party's overall increase in support. (특히 주목받은 것은 민주당의 텃밭인 호남 지역의 여론이다. 호남 지역의 민주당 지지율은 전주 대비 11.2%포인트 올라 민주당의 지지도 상승을 이끌었다.)

In the second week of May survey, the Democratic Party's approval rating in Honam had plummeted by 14.3 percentage points to 57.2% due to internal discord over local election nominations. At that time, the PPP's approval rating rose 7.4 percentage points from the previous week to 20.7%. However, in just one week, the Democratic Party largely recovered its support. Conversely, in this survey, the PPP's approval rating in Honam fell 9.8 percentage points to 10.9%. (5월 2주차 조사 때는 민주당의 지방선거 관련 공천 잡음 탓에 호남 지역 민주당 지지도가 14.3%p나 급락해 57.2%을 기록했었다. 당시 국민의힘 지지율은 전주 대비 7.4%p 상승해 20.7%를 기록했다. 그런데 한 주 만에 민주당이 지지율을 상당 부분 회복한 것이다. 반대로 이번 조사에서 호남 지역의 국민의힘 지지도는 9.8%p 하락한 10.9%였다.)

Realmeter analyzed, "The Democratic Party seems to have boosted its approval rating by responding strongly to the Starbucks 'Tank Day' controversy, using the May 18th anniversary to rally support in the Gwangju and Jeolla regions, as well as among those in their 20s and students." Following the Tank Day controversy, the Democratic Party ordered its local election candidates to boycott Starbucks and announced plans to push for a 'May 18th Mockery Prevention Act'. (리얼미터는 “민주당이 스타벅스 ‘탱크데이’ 폄훼 논란에 강경 대응하며, 5·18 기념일을 계기로 광주·전라 지역과 20대·학생층의 결집을 이끌어내며 지지율 상승으로 이어진 것으로 보인다”고 분석했다. 민주당은 탱크데이 논란 이후 지방선거 후보자들에게 스타벅스 이용 금지령을 내렸고, ‘5·18 조롱 금지법’을 추진하겠다고 했다.)

Meanwhile, in a separate Realmeter survey conducted from the 18th to the 22nd, targeting 2,507 voters nationwide aged 18 and over, President Lee Jae-myung's approval rating for state affairs fell 1.2 percentage points from the previous week to 59.3%. The president's approval rating had exceeded 60% after rising over the previous two weeks but turned to a decline after three weeks. Realmeter analyzed, "Positive evaluations initially rose due to hints of invoking emergency arbitration powers in the Samsung Electronics strike and public criticism of the May 18th 'Tank Day' controversy, but then shifted to a downward trend amid negative coverage of the Samsung Electronics bonus settlement and the strengthening of conservative solidarity with the start of official campaigning for the June 3rd local elections." (한편 리얼미터가 18~22일 전국 18세 이상 2507명을 대상으로 조사한 결과, 이재명 대통령의 국정수행 지지도는 전주 대비 1.2%p 하락한 59.3%를 기록했다. 이 대통령 지지도는 최근 2주간 상승하면서 60%를 넘겼지만, 3주 만에 하락세로 전환했다. 리얼미터는 “삼성전자 파업 관련 긴급 조정권 발동 시사와 5·18 ‘탱크데이’ 논란 공개 질타 등으로 긍정 평가가 상승하는 모습을 보이다 삼성전자 성과급 타결을 둘러싼 부정적 보도 확산, 6·3 지방선거 공식 선거운동 개시와 함께 보수층 결집이 강화돼 하락세로 전환됐다”고 분석했다.)

Both the presidential approval and party approval surveys were conducted using wireless automated response (ARS) methods. The presidential approval survey had a sampling error of ±2.0 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, with a response rate of 4.7%. The party approval survey had a sampling error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level, with a response rate of 4.3%. For more details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website. (대통령 지지도 조사와 정당 지지도 조사는 무선 자동응답(ARS) 방식으로 진행됐다. 대통령 지지도 조사의 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±2.0%p, 응답률은 4.7%였다. 정당 지지도 조사의 표본 오차는 95% 신뢰 수준에 ±3.1%p, 응답률은 4.3%다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조.)

item.title: Kim Yong-bum: "High Interest, High Prices, High Exchange Rate Are Costs of Success"... Opposition: "Serious Distortion of Reality" (김용범 “고금리·고물가·고환율은 성공의 비용“... 野 ”심각한 현실왜곡”)
item.description:
Kim Yong-bum: "High Interest, High Prices, High Exchange Rate Are Costs of Success"... Opposition: "Serious Distortion of Reality" (김용범 “고금리·고물가·고환율은 성공의 비용“... 野 ”심각한 현실왜곡”)

Kim Yong-bum, the presidential chief of staff for policy at the Blue House, described the so-called "three highs" (high interest rates, high prices, and high exchange rates) as "inevitable costs of success accompanying Korea's leap to a new level," stating, "They are not a precursor to a crisis, but the friction of a leap forward." The People Power Party criticized this as a "serious distortion of reality." <<> On the 24th, Kim posted on Facebook under the title "Costs of Success," saying, "Corporate performance is hitting record highs and exports are booming, yet interest rates rise, exchange rates are unstable, and housing prices are fluctuating again." He added, "This seemingly contradictory phenomenon unfolding simultaneously has the market and public opinion busy searching for signs of crisis." Amid growing concerns over the "three highs," he argued that a shift in perspective on the economy is necessary. <<> Kim diagnosed the high exchange rate phenomenon as a "paradoxical outcome of the KOSPI's rise." He stated, "It does not stem from a foreign currency shortage, as during the foreign exchange crisis," but rather explained, "The KOSPI has surged over 70% this year, doubling the value of foreign-held domestic stocks to 2,600 trillion won, and unprecedented foreign selling has driven up exchange rates through demand for currency conversion." He added, "This is not a weakness of the Korean economy but a paradoxical result of success, and the situation should be assessed by focusing on foreign currency supply and demand flows and liquidity indicators, rather than the exchange rate level itself." <<> Regarding the high interest rates, Kim said, "They are the result of complex factors, including global inflationary concerns driven by oil prices, potential tightening shifts in major countries' monetary policies, and expectations of a base rate hike." He noted, "Both approaches—unconditionally suppressing upward pressure on rates and leaving high rates unchecked—are risky. What is needed now is to manage rates so they don't excessively outpace economic fundamentals while ensuring shocks are not concentrated in vulnerable sectors." However, he added, "For the price issue in particular, relying solely on market functions is insufficient," emphasizing that "an extraordinary response is required, mobilizing all available policy tools such as stabilizing energy prices, reforming unfair market structures like collusion, supporting vulnerable groups with vouchers, and flexibly adjusting stockpile reserves." <<> Kim also noted increasing upward pressure on housing prices, saying, "Structural demand management measures to curb speculative demand and block capital concentration in real estate should be implemented alongside supply policies." <<> In response, People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk posted on Facebook, calling it "a consideration of misinterpreting from start to finish," and said, "Rather than deceiving the public with flashy words, the proper attitude for a policy leader is to contemplate measures to address the crisis." Jang stated, "While semiconductor supercycles have led to explosive export growth, exports of major items excluding semiconductors have actually decreased by 1.1%. It's terrifying to even think about what reality our economy will face if semiconductors stumble, or how we will handle the impact if the U.S. Federal Reserve raises rates." Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon also said, "The suffering of small business owners burdened by loan interest and ordinary people sighing over grocery prices cannot be justified as costs of success," adding, "This is ultimately typical wordplay and an out-of-body rhetoric to conceal real crises that penetrate people's lives and the government's incompetence." <<> In defense against the opposition's criticism, Democratic Party Secretary General Cho Seung-rae said, "Aren't the 'three highs' just the given reality? The external environment itself is like that," and argued, "The claim (of the People Power Party) is ignorance stemming from a misinterpretation." (김용범 청와대 정책실장은 이른바 3고(고금리·고물가·고환율) 현상에 대해 “한국경제가 새로운 차원으로 도약하는 과정에서 불가피하게 수반되는 성공의 비용”이라며 “위기의 전조가 아니라 도약의 마찰음”이라고 했다. 국민의힘은 “심각한 현실왜곡”이라고 비판했다.)

item.title: Park Hyung-joon: "Exchange rate at 1,515 won, yet President Lee only focuses on election campaigns via SNS" (박형준 “환율 1515원인데... 李, SNS로 선거판만 살펴”)
item.description:
Park Hyung-joon: "Exchange rate at 1,515 won, yet President Lee only focuses on election campaigns via SNS" (박형준 “환율 1515원인데... 李, SNS로 선거판만 살펴”)

People Power Party's Busan mayoral candidate Park Hyung-joon said on the 25th, "Today's exchange rate is 1,515 won. President Lee Jae-myung, where are you looking right now?" (국민의힘 박형준 부산시장 후보가 25일 “오늘자 환율 1515원인데 이재명 대통령, 지금 어디 보고 계십니까”라고 했다.)

In a Facebook post that afternoon, Park stated, "Calling the high exchange rate, high prices, and high interest rates 'friction sounds of a leap' and interpreting a crisis as success—this is the reality of South Korea right now." (박 후보는 이날 오후 자신의 페이스북에 글을 올리고 “고환율·고물가·고금리를 ‘도약의 마찰음’이라 부르며 위기를 성공으로 읽는 나라, 지금 대한민국의 현실”이라며 이같이 밝혔다.)

He asked, "Does the president remember what party leader Lee Jae-myung said?" adding, "In April 2024, when the exchange rate broke 1,400 won, he cried out that the national economic crisis was becoming reality. In February 2025, he condemned the previous administration's mismanagement, saying people's assets were dwindling by 7%." (그는 “대통령은 이재명 당대표가 했던 말을 기억하시냐”며 “2024년 4월, (환율) 1400원 돌파에 ‘국가 경제 위기 현실화’를 외쳤다. 2025년 2월엔 ‘국민 재산이 7%씩 날아갔다’며 전 정권의 실정으로 규탄했다”고 했다.)

He then pointed to the current high exchange rate situation. "The exchange rate, which was 1,395 won when President Lee took office, has now reached 1,515 won," he said. "This is the highest level in 17 years since the 2009 financial crisis. The numbers have worsened, so why has the sense of crisis disappeared?" He added, "While major global currencies are strengthening against the dollar, only the won is weakening. This is the cold gaze of international financial markets on the Korean economy." (그러면서 현재 고환율 상황을 지적했다. “이재명 대통령 출범 당시 1395원이던 환율은 (현재) 1515원이 됐다”며 “2009년 금융위기 이후 17년 만의 수준이다. 숫자는 더 나빠졌는데, 위기의식은 왜 사라졌느냐”고 했다. 이어 “세계 주요국 통화가 달러 대비 강세를 보이는 지금, 유독 원화만 약세”라며 “이것이 국제 금융시장이 한국 경제를 바라보는 냉정한 시선”이라고 했다.)

Park asked, "Is this administration focused on people's livelihoods or on elections?" He continued, "The president is absorbed in shaking up the local election landscape with daily SNS offensives. A government that doesn't defend the exchange rate, doesn't care about people's livelihoods, and only monitors the election scene. The people are watching it all." (박 후보는 “지금 이 정부가 신경 쓰는 건 민생이냐 선거냐”고 했다. 그는 “대통령은 연일 SNS 공세로 지방선거 구도를 흔들 생각에 골몰하고 있다”며 “환율은 방어하지 않고, 민생은 챙기지 않고, 선거판은 살피는 정부. 국민이 다 보고 있다”고 했다.)

He then said, "We will handle the elections ourselves. Mr. President, please defend the soaring exchange rate and focus entirely on people's livelihoods," adding, "I will create a path for Busan that prioritizes protecting the lives of its citizens." (그러면서 “선거는 저희가 알아서 하겠다. 대통령은 치솟는 환율을 방어하고, 민생에 올인해 달라”며 “부산 시민의 삶을 먼저 지키는 부산의 길을 만들어가겠다”고 했다.)

item.title: “I Want to Live in a Country Where I Have the Freedom to Choose My Coffee”: People Power Party’s Kim Ki-hyun Posts Starbucks ‘Certification Photo’ (“커피 선택할 자유있는 나라에서 살고 싶다” 국힘 김기현 스벅 ‘인증샷’)
item.description:
“I Want to Live in a Country Where I Have the Freedom to Choose My Coffee”: People Power Party’s Kim Ki-hyun Posts Starbucks ‘Certification Photo’ (“커피 선택할 자유있는 나라에서 살고 싶다” 국힘 김기현 스벅 ‘인증샷’)

People Power Party lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun posted a photo of himself drinking coffee at Starbucks in election-campaign attire on the morning of the 25th. This was interpreted as a protest against President Lee Jae-myung and the Democratic Party of Korea’s successive attacks on Starbucks Korea, which sparked controversy by promoting ‘Tank Day’ marketing on the May 18 commemoration day. (김기현 국민의힘 의원이 25일 오전 선거복 차림으로 스타벅스에서 커피를 마시는 사진을 올렸다. 5·18 기념일에 ‘탱크데이’ 마케팅을 진행해 논란을 자초한 스타벅스코리아에 대해 이재명 대통령과 더불어민주당이 잇따라 공세를 퍼붓는 것에 대해 반발하는 것으로 해석됐다.)

Kim wrote on his Facebook page that morning, alongside the photo, “I want to live in a country where the state does not decide the coffee I drink, but where I have the freedom to choose.” The previous day, Kim had also stated, “At this point, it’s no exaggeration to say that President Lee’s social media is becoming a massive form of ‘state violence.’ It feels like we’re witnessing a North Korean dictatorship’s people’s trial in 21st-century South Korea.” (김 의원은 이날 오전 자신의 페이스북에 사진을 올리고 “나는 내가 마실 커피를 국가가 결정하는 것이 아니라 내가 선택할 자유가 있는 나라에서 살고 싶다”고 적었다. 김 의원은 전날에도 “이쯤 되면 이 대통령의 SNS가 거대한 ‘국가폭력’이 되어가고 있다고 해도 과언이 아니다”라며 “마치 북한 독재정권의 인민재판을 21세기 대한민국에서 보는 듯하다”고 했다.)

Earlier, on the 18th, President Lee publicly criticized Starbucks Korea’s ‘Tank Day’ marketing, saying, “I am outraged by the inhuman, low-life behavior of these cheap merchants,” and the Democratic Party subsequently issued orders for its local election candidates to refrain from using Starbucks. In response, analyses from opposition circles suggested that “ahead of the local elections, this is an attempt to divide voters and rally the Democratic Party’s support base, such as in the Honam region.” (앞서 지난 18일 이 대통령은 스타벅스코리아의 ‘탱크데이’ 마케팅에 대해 “저질 장사치의 비인간적 막장 행태에 분노한다”고 공개 비판했고 민주당도 지방선거 후보들에게 잇따라 ‘스타벅스 이용 자제령’을 내렸다. 그러자 야권을 중심으로 “지방선거를 앞두고 유권자를 갈라치기하면서 호남 등 민주당 지지층을 결집시키려는 의도”라는 분석이 나왔다.)

The People Power Party has criticized President Lee and the Democratic Party, calling it a ‘state-led boycott movement’ and ‘excessive corporate bashing.’ (국민의힘은 이 대통령과 민주당을 향해 ‘관제 불매 운동’ ‘지나친 기업 때리기’라고 비판하고 나섰다.)

People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk said during a Central Election Committee meeting that morning, “They are trying to redirect the public anger over Lee Jae-myung’s trial-cancellation special counsel proposal toward Starbucks,” calling it a “people’s trial for the local elections.” He added, “The target of this election’s ‘death song’ is Starbucks. Is it the death song, or is it Starbucks? I hope the people will judge.” (장동혁 국민의힘 대표는 이날 오전 중앙선대위 회의에서 “이재명 재판취소 특검에 분노한 민심을 스타벅스로 돌리려 하고 있다”며 “지방선거용 인민재판”이라고 했다. 그러면서 “이번 선거 죽창가의 대상은 스타벅스다. 죽창가냐 스타벅스냐. 국민들께서 심판해주기 바란다”고 했다.)

People Power Party floor leader Song Un-seok also warned President Lee, saying, “Ahead of the elections, SNS politics targeting Starbucks and Musinsa is spiraling out of control,” and “I strongly warn you to immediately stop interfering in the elections and focus on taking care of the people’s livelihood and economy.” (송언석 국민의힘 원내대표도 이 대통령을 향해 “선거를 앞두고 스타벅스, 무신사 저격 등 SNS 정치가 폭주하고 있다”며 “선거 개입을 즉각 중단하고 민생 경제를 돌보는 데 전념하길 강력히 경고한다”고 했다.)

item.description:
Park Geun-hye visits Chungcheong after Daegu: "Must give belief that promises will be kept"... Heading to PK and Gangwon-do (대구 이어 충청 찾은 박근혜 “약속 지킨다는 믿음 줘야”... PK·강원도 간다)

Former President Park Geun-hye visited the birthplace of her mother, Yuk Young-soo, in Okcheon, North Chungcheong Province on the 25th, along with Kim Young-hwan, the People Power Party candidate for North Chungcheong Province governor running in the June 3 local elections. Following her visit to a traditional market in Daegu to support Deputy Prime Minister Choo Kyung-ho's campaign for Daegu mayor, she is expanding her scope of activity to rally conservative support, analysts say. <<> Former President Park appeared at Yuk Young-soo's birthplace around 11 a.m. that day, dressed in a white jacket and black pants. She toured the house for about 20 minutes. Accompanying her on the schedule were Kim Young-hwan, candidate for North Chungcheong governor, Jeon Sang-in, candidate for Okcheon county mayor, and lawmakers Park Deok-heum and Eom Tae-young. <<> Hundreds of supporters of former President Park gathered at the scene that day. She readily responded to supporters' requests for photos together. <<> Meeting with reporters that day, former President Park said, "If (the candidates) give the belief that they will keep their promises, the people will recognize it and make their choice. I believe that Governor candidate Kim Young-hwan and candidate Jeon Sang-in are people who can give (that belief)." <<> In the afternoon, former President Park plans to personally visit the campaign office of Lee Jang-woo, the People Power Party candidate for Daejeon mayor, in Seo-gu, Daejeon, to encourage him. Afterwards, she plans to visit Gongju Sanseong Market in South Chungcheong Province with Governor Kim Tae-heum to meet merchants and citizens. <<> Former President Park's election campaign support marks her first such activity in about nine years since her impeachment in 2017. item.title: 'Garden of Gratitude' Becomes Election Issue: Gwanghwamun Square Visitors Surpass 1.34 Million in Just 10 Days of Opening (‘선거 쟁점’ 감사의 정원, 개장 열흘만 광장 방문객 134만명 돌파)
item.description:
'Garden of Gratitude' Becomes Election Issue: Gwanghwamun Square Visitors Surpass 1.34 Million in Just 10 Days of Opening (‘선거 쟁점’ 감사의 정원, 개장 열흘만 광장 방문객 134만명 돌파)

Data released on the 25th showed that the number of visitors to Gwanghwamun Square has surged significantly in the ten days since the opening of the 'Garden of Gratitude', a space created by the Seoul Metropolitan Government to honor the nations that participated in the Korean War. This figure is nearly double the number of visitors to Gwanghwamun Square during the same period last year. The surge is attributed to citizens flocking to see the 'Light Pillar Night View' during the three-day holiday that began on the 23rd. The Garden of Gratitude has also emerged as a key issue in the June 3 local elections, after Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea's candidate for Seoul Mayor, suggested its removal or relocation. (6·25전쟁 참전국에 대한 예우를 담아 서울시가 조성한 ‘감사의 정원’ 개장 열흘 만에 광화문광장 방문객이 큰 폭으로 증가한 것으로 25일 나타났다. 이는 지난해 같은 기간 광화문광장 방문객의 두 배에 이르는 수준으로, 지난 23일부터 사흘간 이어지는 연휴 기간 ‘빛기둥 야경’을 보기 위해 시민들이 몰린 것으로 분석된다. 더불어민주당 정원오 서울시장 후보가 철거·이전을 시사하면서 감사의 정원은 6·3 지방선거의 쟁점으로도 부상하고 있다.)

According to Seoul's real-time city data, from the 13th to the 23rd, following the opening of the Garden of Gratitude, the number of visitors to Gwanghwamun Square was tallied at 1,347,350. This is nearly double the 710,750 visitors recorded during the same period last year. The Seoul city government explained that the global recognition of Gwanghwamun Square increased following BTS's comeback performance in March, and visitor numbers have risen with the opening of the Garden of Gratitude on the 12th. (서울 실시간 도시 데이터에 따르면 감사의 정원 개장 이후 13~23일까지 광화문광장 방문객은 134만7350명으로 집계됐다. 이는 지난해 같은 기간 광화문광장 방문객(71만750명) 대비 두 배에 가깝다. 지난 3월 방탄소년단(BTS) 컴백 공연으로 광화문광장의 글로벌 인지도가 높아졌고, 지난 12일 개장한 감사의 정원 개장으로 방문객이 늘었다는 것이 서울시 설명이다.)

On the weekend of the 24th alone, 4,126 people visited the 'Freedom Hall', an interactive media space. Since the 13th, the cumulative number of visitors to Freedom Hall has reached 20,000. The 'Light of Gratitude', symbolizing the 23 countries that participated in the Korean War, has become a hot topic on social media. A Seoul city official stated, "As visits to Gwanghwamun Square increase to see the 'Light of Gratitude', we have decided to extend the lighting hours from 8 PM to midnight every night." (실제 주말인 지난 24일 하루에만 미디어 체험 공간인 프리덤홀에 4126명이 다녀간 것으로 나타났다. 프리덤홀에는 지난 13일부터 누적 방문자가 2만명에 달한다. 6·25전쟁에 참전한 23개국(國)을 상징하는 ‘감사의 빛’은 소셜미디어(SNS) 공간에서 화제가 되고 있다. 서울시 측은 “‘감사의 빛’을 보기 위해 광화문광장 방문객이 증가하면서 점등 시간도 매일 저녁 8시부터 자정까지 확대 운영하기로 했다”고 밝혔다.)

Separate from this popularity, the ruling and opposition parties are engaged in a battle over the Garden of Gratitude in the Seoul mayoral election. The Democratic Party points out that the 'Present Arms' shaped formation of the Garden of Gratitude is an eyesore, is a display of wasteful administrative spending of taxpayer money, and was opened as the election approaches. (이 같은 흥행과는 별개로 여야는 서울시장 선거에서 감사의 정원 공방전을 벌이고 있다. 민주당은 ‘받들어 총’ 형상인 감사의 정원이 흉물(凶物)이고, 무리하게 혈세가 투입된 전시행정인 데다 선거가 다가오는 가운데 개장했다는 점을 지적하고 있다.)

Jeong Won-oh, the Democratic Party candidate, said at a forum hosted by the Gwanghun Club on the 20th, "Did it have to be located there? It could be moved to a suitable location like the War Memorial of Korea." Earlier, in a media interview on the 18th, he stated, "If I become mayor, I will thoroughly review all excessive display-oriented administrative projects that have spent a lot of taxpayer money, and if there is no public consensus, I will boldly suspend or adjust them." This signals his intention to consider relocation or removal. (정원오 민주당 후보는 지난 20일 관훈클럽 초청 토론회에서 “위치가 그곳이어야 했나. 용산 전쟁기념관 등 적당한 장소로 조형물을 이전할 수 있다”고 했다. 이보다 앞선 지난 18일 언론 인터뷰에선 “제가 시장이 된다면 막대한 혈세가 투입된 무리한 전시 행정 사업들은 전면 재점검하고 시민 공감대가 없다면 과감히 중단하거나 조정할 것”이라고 밝혔다. 이전·철거를 검토하겠다는 것이다.)

The Democratic Party is continuing its aggressive offensive, even organizing relay protests against the Garden of Gratitude. Park Kyung-mi, spokesperson for the Jeong Won-oh campaign, claimed in a statement, "The completion ceremony of the Garden of Gratitude was, in a word, a 'total flop'. The backlash is severe." Cheon Jun-ho, the Democratic Party's senior deputy floor leader, also said, "A 'Present Arms' pose is unsuitable for the sacred ground of South Korea's democracy, which overcame martial law." The Democratic Party has also filed a complaint with the police, arguing that Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul Mayor, violated election law by giving a congratulatory speech at the Garden of Gratitude's completion ceremony. (민주당은 감사의 정원 릴레이 규탄 시위까지 전개하면서 파상공세를 이어가고 있다. ‘정원오 선대위’ 박경미 대변인은 성명에서 “감사의 정원 준공식은 한마디로 ‘폭망’했다. 역풍이 거세다”고 주장했고, 천준호 민주당 원내수석부대표도 “내란을 이겨낸 대한민국 민주주의의 성지에 ‘받들어 총’은 어울리지 않는다”고 했다. 민주당은 국민의힘 오세훈 서울시장 후보가 감사의 정원 준공식에서 축사를 한 것이 선거법 위반이라며 경찰에 고발하기도 했다.)

The People Power Party is fighting back, calling it "a replay of the old-fashioned Democratic Party that cursed the Cheonggyecheon restoration project." Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul Mayor, met with reporters after announcing his tourism pledges on the 19th and stated, "A sentiment is forming, especially among the younger generation, that the Garden of Gratitude is worth visiting." He added, "You must all be witnessing the explosive response it's receiving on social media platforms like Instagram." (국민의힘도 “청계천 복원을 저주했던 민주당 구태의 재방송”이라면서 반박하고 있다. 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보는 지난 19일 관광 공약 발표 이후 기자들과 만나 “젊은 층을 중심으로 감사의 정원은 방문해 볼 만하다는 분위기가 형성되고 있다”며 “인스타그램을 비롯한 SNS 공간에서 폭발적인 호응이 일어나는 것은 다 지켜보고 계실 것”이라고 했다.)

In a previous interview with this publication, Candidate Oh said, "When I promoted the Han River Renaissance 20 years ago, the Democratic Party vehemently opposed it, saying, 'The Han River is only good when left alone.' I wonder if those Democratic Party members who opposed it back then aren't now spending pleasant weekends with their families by the Han River." (오 후보는 앞서 본지 인터뷰에서는 “20년 전 한강 르네상스를 추진할 때 민주당 측이 ‘한강은 가만히 놔둘 때 비로소 좋다’면서 극렬 반대했다”며 “그때 반대했던 민주당 분도 지금쯤 주말이면 가족들과 한강에서 즐거운 시간을 보내고 있지 않겠나”라고 했었다.)

Choi Soo-jin, the head of the public relations team for the People Power Party campaign, also stated, "The act of disparaging this noble space of patriotism as an eyesore is a replay of the old-fashioned Democratic Party that cursed the Cheonggyecheon restoration 24 years ago. Candidate Jeong Won-oh should leave the debate stage with the microphone on and face the stern judgment of the citizens." (최수진 국민의힘 선대위 공보단장도 “숭고한 보훈 공간을 흉물로 깎아내리는 작태는 24년 전 청계천 복원을 저주했던 민주당 구태의 재방송”이라며 “정원오 후보는 마이크가 켜진 토론장부터 나와서 시민의 엄중한 심판을 받으라”고 했다.)

Shin Joo-ho, spokesperson for the Oh Se-hoon campaign, said, "Citizen foot traffic to the Garden of Gratitude is exploding. The election of Candidate Jeong, who wants to tear this down, means a return to the bleak era of Park Won-soon." (‘오세훈 선대위’ 신주호 대변인은 “감사의 정원에 시민의 발걸음이 폭발적으로 늘고 있다”며 “이것을 철거하겠다는 정 후보의 당선은 암울한 박원순 시절로 돌아간다는 의미”라고 했다.)

item.title: Jeon Jae-soo 47.4%, Park Hyung-joon 41.5%... Ha Jung-woo 34%, Han Dong-hoon 38.2% (전재수 47.4% 박형준 41.5%... 하정우 34% 한동훈 38.2%)
item.description:
A poll released on the 25th showed that in Busan, a battleground for the June 3 local elections, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo and People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon are in a tight race within the margin of error. In the three-way race for the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon is leading Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo and People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik within the margin of error. (6·3 지방선거 격전지인 부산에서 더불어민주당 전재수 후보와 국민의힘 박형준 후보가 오차 범위 내에서 접전을 벌이고 있다는 여론조사 결과가 25일 나왔다. 3자 대결 구도로 치러지는 부산 북갑 국회의원 보궐선거 지지도 조사에서는 무소속 한동훈 후보가 민주당 하정우 후보, 국민의힘 박민식 후보를 오차 범위 내에서 따돌리고 있는 것으로 나타났다.)

According to a Busan mayoral approval poll (wireless ARS survey) conducted by Ace Research commissioned by the Busan Ilbo on the 23rd and 24th among 1,002 voters in the Busan area, Democratic Party candidate Jeon Jae-soo received 47.4% and People Power Party candidate Park Hyung-joon received 41.5%. The gap between the two candidates was 5.9 percentage points (p), within the margin of error (±3.1%p). (여론조사 회사 에이스리서치가 부산일보 의뢰로 지난 23~24일 부산 지역 유권자 1002명을 대상으로 실시한 부산시장 지지도 조사(무선 ARS 조사)에서 민주당 전재수 후보는 47.4%, 국민의힘 박형준 후보는 41.5%를 얻었다. 두 후보의 지지도 격차는 5.9%포인트(p)로 오차 범위(±3.1%p) 안이었다.)

In a hypothetical two-way matchup survey conducted by the same firm on the 3rd and 4th of last month, the gap between Jeon and Park was 13.1 percentage points. In about a month, Park narrowed the gap by around 7.2 percentage points, but the poll showed he hasn't managed to overtake his rival. In polls for local government heads, Democratic Party candidates are generally leading People Power Party candidates within or around the margin of error. (같은 회사가 지난달 3~4일 실시한 가상 양자 대결 조사에서는 전 후보와 박 후보의 격차가 13.1%포인트였다. 한 달여 만에 박 후보가 7.2%포인트가량 따라붙었지만, 지지율 역전까지는 이르지 못한 것으로 조사됐다. 기초단체장 지지도 조사에서도 민주당 후보들이 오차 범위 안팎에서 국민의힘 후보들을 대체로 앞서는 양상이다.)

In the Busan Buk-gu Gap by-election held alongside the local elections, independent candidate Han Dong-hoon recorded 38.2%, Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo 34%, and People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik 23.3%. This survey was conducted on the 23rd and 24th among 502 voters in the Busan Buk-gu Gap district. Han led Ha within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). Park ranked third, trailing Han and Ha outside the margin of error. (지방선거와 함께 치러지는 부산 북갑 보궐선거에서는 무소속 한동훈 후보 38.2%, 민주당 하정우 후보 34%, 국민의힘 박민식 후보 23.3% 순으로 집계됐다. 이번 조사는 부산 북갑 지역구 유권자 502명을 대상으로 지난 23~24일 실시됐다. 한 후보는 오차 범위(±4.4%포인트) 내에서 하 후보에 앞섰다. 박 후보는 오차 범위 밖에서 한 후보, 하 후보에 밀리는 3위였다.)

A poll conducted by Gallup Korea on the 21st and 22nd for the Segye Ilbo also showed independent candidate Han Dong-hoon (36%) and Democratic Party candidate Ha Jung-woo (35%) in an extremely tight race within the margin of error (±4.4 percentage points). People Power Party candidate Park Min-shik was third at 19%, chasing from outside the margin of error. With ten days remaining until the election, a pattern of two strong candidates and one moderate contender is solidifying. (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) (여론조사회사 한국갤럽이 세계일보 의뢰로 21~22일 실시한 조사에서도 무소속 한동훈(36%) 후보와 민주당 하정우(35%) 후보가 오차 범위(±4.4%포인트)에서 초박빙 승부를 펼치는 것으로 나타났다. 국민의힘 박민식 후보는 오차 범위 바깥에서 추격하는 19%였다. 선거를 열흘 앞두고 2강 1중 구도가 고착화되는 양상이다. (자세한 사항은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 홈페이지 참조).)

Regarding this clear trend in recent polls, People Power Party candidate Park said at a press conference that day, "The poll samples themselves are politically contaminated." He further claimed, "Some polls are being distorted into a tool to influence elections and warp public opinion rather than objectively gauge the public's mood." (최근 발표되는 여론조사에서 이 같은 추세가 뚜렷해지는 데 대해 국민의힘 박 후보는 이날 기자회견에서 “여론조사 표본 자체가 정치적으로 오염되어 있다”고 했다. 그러면서 “일부 여론조사가 객관적인 민심 파악이 아니라 선거에 영향을 미치고 여론을 왜곡하는 수단으로 변질되고 있다”고 주장하기도 했다.)

In response to Park's denial of the poll results, independent candidate Han said, "It's a regrettable behavior that's hit rock bottom," adding, "This trend in approval ratings isn't from one specific outlet; it's a common phenomenon across multiple media." Regarding his own rise, Han noted, "There's a strong fatigue among residents over the stagnation of regional development during the era of former Reps. Jeon Jae-soo and Park Min-shik." (박 후보가 여론조사 결과들을 부정하는 데 대해 무소속 한 후보는 “막장까지 간 안타까운 행태”라며 “현재의 지지율 추이는 특정 기관 한 곳이 아니라 여러 매체에서 공통으로 나타나는 현상”이라고 했다. 자신의 상승세와 관련해 한 후보는 “그동안 이 지역을 이끌었던 전재수·박민식 의원의 시대 동안 지역 발전이 정체됐다는 주민들의 피로감이 크다”고 했다.)

Democratic Party candidate Ha appeared on a pro-Democratic Party YouTube channel that day and said, "There are so many supporters of candidate Han Dong-hoon that it sometimes feels like they're practically campaign workers," adding, "The problem is that too many outsiders have come in, and this is significantly disrupting and muddying the waters of the Buk-gu election itself." (민주당 하 후보는 이날 친(親)민주당 유튜브 채널에 나와 “한동훈 후보 지지자가 숫자가 워낙 많아 거의 사실상 선거 사무원 같다는 느낌이 들 때도 있다”며 “문제는 외부에서 온 사람이 너무 많은데 이런 것들이 북구 선거 자체를 상당히 망치고 물 흐리는 상황”이라고 했다.)

item.title: During a campaign rally for Jeong Cheong-rae in Jeonju, a surprise protest shouting “Step down” took place, prompting police to launch an investigation. (정청래 전주 지원 유세 중 “물러가라” 기습 시위… 경찰, 수사 착수 )
item.description:
A surprise protest opposing Representative Jeong Cheong-rae of the Democratic Party of Korea broke out at a campaign rally venue in Jeonju, leading police to initiate an investigation. (더불어민주당 정청래 대표의 전주 지원 유세 현장에서 정 대표를 반대하는 기습 시위가 벌어져 경찰이 수사에 착수했다.)

On the 25th, the Jeonju Deokjin Police Station in North Jeolla Province announced that it had booked participants of the surprise protest on suspicion of violating the Public Official Election Act (prohibition of disruptive acts at assembly halls) and is investigating them. (전북 전주덕진경찰서는 공직선거법 위반(연설회장에서의 소란 행위 등의 금지) 혐의로 기습 시위 가담자들을 입건해 조사 중이라고 25일 밝혔다.)

According to police, around 2:40 p.m. that day, approximately 10 individuals, including members of the “Provincial Countermeasures Committee to Stop Jeong Cheong-rae’s Domination of the Party,” staged a surprise protest at a rally in front of the old main gate of Jeonbuk National University in Deokjin-gu, Jeonju, where Representative Jeong was campaigning for Democratic Party candidates from the North Jeolla region. (경찰 등에 따르면 이날 오후 2시 40분쯤 전주시 덕진구 전북대학교 옛 정문 앞 광장에서 열린 정 대표의 민주당 소속 전북 지역 후보 지원 유세 현장에서 ‘정청래 사당화 저지 범도민대책위원회’ 관계자 등 10여 명이 기습 시위를 벌였다.)

As Jeong was about to board the campaign vehicle to give a speech, they held up hand signs reading “Jeong Cheong-rae OUT” and shouted, “Step down, Jeong Cheong-rae!” and “Unfair nominations.” Despite security personnel and police intervening, it is reported that there were loud verbal exchanges and physical scuffles between Democratic Party officials attempting to proceed with the rally and the countermeasures committee. (이들은 정 대표가 연설을 하기 위해 유세 차량에 올라서자 ‘정청래 OUT’이라고 적힌 손팻말을 들고 “정청래는 물러가라” “불공정 공천”이라고 소리쳤다. 경호 인력과 경찰이 이들을 제지했지만, 유세를 진행하려는 민주당 관계자들과 대책위 사이에 고성과 신체적 마찰도 빚어졌다고 한다.)

The North Jeolla Provincial Party of the Democratic Party issued a statement asserting, “This goes beyond simple election interference and constitutes a planned, organized disruption of the venue,” adding, “It is an illegal act threatening democracy, a clear crime that exceeds the bounds of freedom of expression.” (민주당 전북도당은 입장문을 통해 “단순한 선거 방해를 넘어 계획적이고 조직적으로 현장을 훼방 놓았다”며 “민주주의를 위협하는 위법 행위로, 표현의 자유를 벗어난 명백한 범죄”라고 주장했다.)

Police reported that while no one was taken into custody at the scene, they have identified some of the protest participants and have booked them. (경찰은 현장에서 연행한 인원은 없지만, 시위 참가자 일부 신원을 특정해 이들을 입건한 것으로 전해졌다.)

A police official stated, “We plan to investigate all participants in the rally, including those whose identities have been confirmed.” <<>> (경찰 관계자는 “신원이 특정된 인원을 포함한 집회 참가자들을 모두 조사할 예정”이라고 했다.)
